description:
Configure the store identity for 'Terra & Clay Studio'. 

1. Go to Stores > Configuration > General > General > Store Information:
   - Store Name: 'Terra & Clay Studio'
   - Phone: '(505) 555-0142'
   - Hours: 'Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sat 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM'
   - Country: United States, State: New Mexico, ZIP: 87501, City: Santa Fe, Street: 214 Canyon Road

2. Go to Stores > Configuration > General > Store Email Addresses:
   - General Contact: 'Terra & Clay Studio' <hello@terraandclay.com>
   - Sales Representative: 'Terra & Clay Orders' <orders@terraandclay.com>
   - Customer Support: 'Terra & Clay Support' <support@terraandclay.com>

3. Configure Design Settings (find under Content > Design > Configuration or Stores > Configuration > General > Design):
   - HTML Head Default Title: 'Terra & Clay Studio | Handcrafted Pottery & Ceramics'
   - HTML Head Default Meta Description: 'Discover handcrafted pottery and ceramics by Elena Vasquez. Unique, artisan-made pieces for your home from Santa Fe, New Mexico.'
   - Header Welcome Text: 'Welcome to Terra & Clay Studio — Handcrafted with love in Santa Fe'
   - Footer Copyright: 'Copyright © 2025 Terra & Clay Studio. All rights reserved.'

Save all configurations.
